data.title: Soybean, corn barge basis steady to mixed as harvest pace picks up
data.description:
Basis bids for soybeans and corn shipped by barge to the US Gulf were steady to mixed on Friday, as the harvest pace in the central US Midwest picked up and empty barges moved north to meet demand, traders said.

  • US corn futures plunged by as much as the daily trading limit on Friday on the Chicago Board of Trade, and ended sharply lower after the US Department of Agriculture shocked traders with an unexpected increase to its 2026 US harvest outlook.

  • CBOT wheat futures followed corn lower, pressured by the USDA's larger-than-expected stock forecast increase, while soybeans bounced from a six-week low to finish the day higher.

  • And spot basis bids for soybeans were generally flat to weaker in the US Midwest on Friday, pressured at a few soy processing sites by the accelerating harvest, dealers said.

  • The range between bids and offers for CIF soybean barges loaded in October widened sharply on Friday, traders said.

  • CIF soybean barges loaded in October were bid at 81 cents over CBOT November soybean (SX26) futures, down 5 cents, while November barge loadings were bid at 108 cents over futures, down 1 cent.

  • FOB export premiums for Gulf soybean shipments in October held steady at around 110 cents over CBOT November soybean (SX26) futures, while November shipments were offered at 117 cents over futures, up 2 cents.

  • CIF corn barges loaded in December traded at 97 cents over CBOT December corn (CZ26) futures.

  • Meanwhile, CIF corn barges loaded in October were bid at 72 cents over CBOT December corn (CZ26) futures, up 2 cents from Thursday, while corn barges loaded in November were bid at 87 cents over December futures, up 3 cents.

  • FOB export premiums for Gulf corn vessels loaded in the first-half of October were up 6 cents at 103 cents over CBOT December corn (CZ26) futures, while vessels loaded in last-half October were offered at 103 cents over December futures, up 8 cents.

data.title: Nasdaq CEO Flags Tens of Billions in New Wall Street Opportunity
data.description:
Nasdaq CEO Adena Friedman says tokenization could unlock tens of billions of dollars currently trapped in collateral, arguing blockchain technology could fundamentally change how money and securities move through global financial markets.

If you tokenize all those instruments along with the flow of money, then the collateral becomes very fluid, Friedman said at TOKEN2049 in Singapore.

Her argument goes beyond crypto speculation. Banks and other financial institutions routinely pledge Treasuries, equities, money-market instruments and other assets as collateral. Converting those assets, alongside cash, into transferable digital tokens could potentially make collateral easier to move and reuse, freeing capital that otherwise sits idle.

If we can tokenize money, then we can tokenize the flow of capital, Friedman said.

Nasdaq itself is already moving in that direction. The Securities and Exchange Commission approved Nasdaq's proposal in March allowing securities to trade in tokenized form, while the exchange is also developing an equity-token framework designed to preserve shareholder rights and existing market protections.

The regulatory backdrop has moved further recently. In September, the SEC granted temporary conditional relief allowing certain venues to trade tokenized U.S. stocks through permissioned on-chain systems, another indication that tokenized securities are moving closer to mainstream financial infrastructure.

Friedman also sees tokenization intersecting with another structural shift: 24/7 markets. Retail investors have pushed toward continuous trading for years, while institutions are now increasingly exploring ways to keep capital moving outside traditional market hours.

Investor Takeaway

The investment story here is much larger than simply putting stocks on a blockchain.

Tokenization could reshape settlement, collateral management, trading and asset servicing, potentially benefiting companies already positioned between traditional finance and digital assets.

Nasdaq has made that strategy increasingly tangible, including a recently announced $100 million investment in Kraken parent Payward as the companies work together on tokenized equities and always-on market infrastructure.

That puts Nasdaq alongside Coinbase , Robinhood , BlackRock , JPMorgan Chase and other financial players pursuing different parts of the tokenization opportunity.

The key question for investors is no longer whether Wall Street experiments with tokenization. It is whether those experiments become sufficiently liquid, regulated and scalable to move meaningful portions of the existing financial system on-chain.

data.title: Alpine Income Property Trust Announces Agreement to Acquire 13-Property Industrial Portfolio for $117.3 Million
data.description:
WINTER PARK, Fla., Oct. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Alpine Income Property Trust, Inc. (the "Company"), an owner and operator of single-tenant net leased commercial income properties, today announced that it has entered into an agreement to acquire a 13-property industrial portfolio for $117.3 million, or $63 per square foot.

The portfolio totals approximately 1.9 million square feet on approximately 209 acres across 11 states. The properties are 100% leased to nine tenants under absolute triple-net leases with a weighted average remaining lease term of 10.2 years, and no lease expires before late 2031. The tenants have operated at their respective sites for an average of approximately 40 years, and many have made significant investments in their facilities. Approximately 19% of in-place cash rent is attributable to tenants that are rated investment grade or are subsidiaries of investment grade rated parents.

"This acquisition will add a portfolio of mission-critical manufacturing and distribution facilities, at a low basis with 10 years of weighted average lease term remaining," said John P. Albright, President and Chief Executive Officer of Alpine Income Property Trust. "We believe that the investment will deliver an attractive initial yield, and that the annual rent escalators built into the leases will support future cash flow growth."

The acquisition is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to the satisfaction of customary closing conditions. The Company expects to fund the acquisition with borrowings under its revolving credit facility, proceeds from select dispositions, and commercial loan repayments.

About Alpine Income Property Trust, Inc.

Alpine Income Property Trust, Inc. is a publicly traded real estate investment trust that seeks to deliver attractive risk-adjusted returns and dependable cash dividends by investing in, owning and operating a portfolio of single tenant net leased commercial income properties that are predominately leased to high-quality publicly traded and credit-rated tenants. The Company also complements its income property portfolio by strategically investing in a select portfolio of commercial loan investments intended to deliver an attractive risk-adjusted return.

We encourage you to review our most recent investor presentation which is available on our website at http://www.alpinereit.com.

data.title: Super Micro Stock Rises After Company Adds Former Intel Veteran to Board
data.description:
Super Micro Computer (SMCI) is refreshing its board with a veteran of Intel's data-center operations, naming Shesha Krishnapura an independent director as Judy Lin prepares to leave. The appointment takes effect Friday, Oct. 9.

Krishnapura spent 35 years at Intel, most recently serving as chief technology officer of Intel IT. He oversaw architecture and engineering for global systems supporting chip design. He also led 25 server designs and helped turn an Intel facility into a LEED Platinum-certified data center of more than 112 megawatts. Since 2016, he has co-developed and taught graduate-level high-performance computing at Stanford University.

The appointment adds high-performance computing and data-center expertise to the board as Super Micro expands its server and infrastructure business for AI workloads. His experience may inform oversight as the company pursues this market, but the move does not signal an immediate change in its financial outlook.

Lin, a director since 2022 and chair of the nominating and governance committee, will retire Oct. 9. Super Micro shares rose 1.5% on Friday morning.

data.title: RLI Announces Leadership Promotions
data.description:
RLI Corp. () today announced the promotion of four leaders, effective immediately.

Kathleen Taylor Promoted to Vice President, Controller & Treasurer

Kathleen Taylor, Vice President, Accounting and Branch Operations, has been promoted to Vice President, Controller & Treasurer. In this expanded role, she will oversee RLI’s Financial Accounting, Reinsurance Accounting, Tax Accounting and Treasury teams.

Taylor joined RLI in 2002 as a Reinsurance Administrator and has since held several accounting and operations leadership roles, most recently serving as Vice President, Accounting and Branch Operations. She has 30 years of experience in accounting, finance and insurance. Taylor holds a bachelor’s degree in accounting from Western Illinois University, is a certified public accountant and holds the Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter designation.

Katie Kappes Promoted to Chief Administrative Officer

Katie Kappes, Vice President, Human Resources, has been promoted to Chief Administrative Officer. She will provide strategic leadership for key corporate support functions, including Human Resources, Branch Operations, Facilities, Print & Mail and Corporate Secretary.

Kappes joined RLI in 2006 as a Compensation & Benefits Accountant and has since held several human resources leadership roles, most recently serving as Vice President, Human Resources. She has 24 years of experience in human resources and insurance. Kappes holds bachelor’s and master’s degrees in accounting from Bradley University, is a certified public accountant and holds the Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter designation.

Amy Braet Promoted to Vice President, Human Resources

Amy Braet, Assistant Vice President, Talent Management, has been promoted to Vice President, Human Resources. She will lead RLI’s Human Resources organization, with responsibility for talent strategy, organizational development and the employee experience.

Braet joined RLI in 2005 as an intern and has since held roles of increasing responsibility, most recently serving as Assistant Vice President, Talent Management. She has 21 years of experience in human resources and the insurance industry. Braet holds a bachelor’s degree and a Master of Business Administration from Bradley University and holds the Professional in Human Resources, Certified Compensation Professional and Certified Benefits Professional designations.

Ross Edwards Promoted to Vice President, Claim Counsel

Ross Edwards, Assistant Vice President, Claim Counsel, has been promoted to Vice President, Claim Counsel. In his new role, he will have executive leadership responsibility for and oversight of company claim-related litigation.

Edwards joined RLI in 2017 as Claim Manager and has since held several claim leadership roles, including Claim Director; Assistant Vice President, Claim; and Assistant Vice President, Claim Counsel. He has 18 years of experience in law and insurance claims. Edwards holds a bachelor’s degree from Indiana University Bloomington and a Juris Doctor from Chicago-Kent College of Law, Illinois Institute of Technology.

“RLI has a long tradition of developing talented people and preparing proven leaders to take on greater responsibility,” said RLI Corp. President & CEO Craig Kliethermes. “Kathleen, Katie, Amy and Ross bring deep expertise, a strong understanding of our business and culture, and the experience to succeed in these new roles. Their leadership will help us build for the future, strengthen our organization and position RLI for continued success.”

ABOUT RLI
RLI Corp. () is a specialty insurer serving niche property, casualty and surety markets. The company provides deep underwriting expertise and superior service to commercial and personal lines customers nationwide. RLI’s products are offered through its insurance subsidiaries RLI Insurance Company, Mt. Hawley Insurance Company and Contractors Bonding and Insurance Company. All of RLI’s subsidiaries are rated A++ “Superior” by AM Best Company. To learn more about RLI, visit www.rlicorp.com.

data.title: Pulse Biosciences Announces Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
data.description:
Pulse Biosciences, Inc. (), the company leveraging its ever evolving novel and proprietary Nanosecond Pulsed Field Ablation™ (nano-PFA or nsPFA™) technology, today announced that the Compensation Committee of its Board of Directors has granted equity awards to two new employees as equity inducement awards outside of the Company's 2017 Equity Incentive Plan, but under the terms of the 2017 Inducement Equity Incentive Plan. The equity awards were approved and issued on October 8, 2026, in accordance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4).

Pulse has awarded inducement options to two new employees to purchase, in aggregate, up to 5,700 shares of Company common stock. The Company’s independent Compensation Committee approved these awards as an inducement to their employment in accordance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4). The stock options have an exercise price of $49.98 per share, which is equal to the closing price of the Company’s common stock on October 8, 2026, and all will be subject to time-based vesting over four years, with 1/4 of each award vesting annually, subject to the employee’s continued employment with Pulse Biosciences. The options are subject to the terms and conditions of the 2017 Inducement Equity Incentive Plan and the award agreements entered into with each recipient.

About Pulse Biosciences®

Pulse Biosciences is a novel bioelectric medicine company committed to health innovation that has the intention as well as potential to improve the quality of life for patients. The Company’s proprietary nPulse™ technology delivers nanosecond pulses of electrical energy to non-thermally clear cells while sparing adjacent non-cellular tissue. The Company is actively pursuing the development of its nPulse technology for use in the treatment of atrial fibrillation and in a select few other markets where it could have a profound positive impact on healthcare for both patients and providers.

Pulse Biosciences, nPulse, Vybrance, CellFX, Nano-Pulse Stimulation, NPS, nsPFA, CellFX nsPFA and the stylized logos are among the trademarks and/or registered trademarks of Pulse Biosciences, Inc. in the United States and other countries.

data.title: Enterprise Financial Services Corp Announces Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
data.description:
Enterprise Financial Services Corp () (“the Company” or “EFSC”) will release its third quarter 2026 financial results on Wednesday, October 21, 2026. The Company will host a conference call and webcast at 10:00 a.m. CT on Thursday, October 22, 2026.

Participate by Dial-In

We encourage participants to pre-register for the conference call using the following link: https://bit.ly/EFSC3Q2026EarningsCallRegistration. Callers who pre-register will be given a conference passcode and unique PIN to gain immediate access to the call and bypass the live operator. Participants may pre-register at any time, including up to and after the call start time. The conference call will be accessible by telephone at 1-833-461-5787, after connecting you may say the name of the conference or enter the Conference ID 416436528.

Participate by Webcast

The webcast will be accessible via the “Investor Relations” page of the Company’s website, https://investor.enterprisebank.com/events-and-presentations. The press release and related presentation slides will be accessible on the website prior to the scheduled call.

Participate by Replay

A recorded replay of the conference call will be available on the website, https://investor.enterprisebank.com/events-and-presentations after the call’s completion. The replay will be available for at least two weeks following the conference call.

Enterprise Financial Services Corp (), with approximately $17.4 billion in assets, is a financial holding company headquartered in Clayton, Missouri. Enterprise Bank & Trust, a Missouri state-chartered trust company with banking powers and a wholly-owned subsidiary of EFSC, operates branch offices in Arizona, California, Kansas, Missouri, Nevada, and New Mexico, and SBA loan and deposit production offices throughout the country. Enterprise Bank & Trust offers a range of business and personal banking services, and wealth management services. Enterprise Trust, a division of Enterprise Bank & Trust, provides financial planning, estate planning, investment management, and trust services to businesses, individuals, institutions, retirement plans and non-profit organizations. Additional information is available at www.enterprisebank.com.

Enterprise Financial Services Corp’s common stock is traded on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol “EFSC.” Please visit our website at www.enterprisebank.com to see our regularly posted material information.
